reviewNotes.fields.complexion: Drafted as the usual word for skin tone / complexion (रंग); a native reader should confirm.
reviewNotes.sections.horoscope: Drafted as कुंडली माहिती; पत्रिका / जन्मपत्रिका is also common.
reviewNotes.sections.career: नोकरी व व्यवसाय, covering jobs and business.
reviewNotes.sections.references: Drafted as संदर्भ (people who vouch for the family).
reviewNotes.fields.highestQualification: शिक्षण, as Marathi biodatas print it; शैक्षणिक पात्रता is the formal phrase.
reviewNotes.fields.community: समाज, the usual Marathi word for community.
reviewNotes.fields.subCaste: पोटजात, the everyday Marathi word for sub-caste.
reviewNotes.fields.rashi: रास, the everyday Marathi form; राशी is also written.
reviewNotes.fields.maternalGotra: Drafted as आजोळचे गोत्र (maternal home's gotra); मामाचे गोत्र is an alternative.
reviewNotes.fields.manglik: Printed as मंगळ (values आहे / नाही / सौम्य मंगळ), as Marathi biodatas do.
reviewNotes.fields.lagnam: लग्नरास, to avoid confusion with लग्न (marriage).
reviewNotes.fields.kulaDevata: कुलदैवत. Marathi biodatas often also print देवक; there is no field for it yet (a custom field covers it).
reviewNotes.fields.muslimSect: Generic पंथ for a sect; a reviewer may prefer another word per community.
reviewNotes.options.maritalStatus.widowed: Gendered pair विधुर / विधवा printed together.
reviewNotes.options.manglik.partial: सौम्य मंगळ ('mild Mangal'), the usual Marathi phrase.
reviewNotes.options.nakshatra.mrigashira: मृग, the Marathi usage; मृगशिरा / मृगशीर्ष also seen.
reviewNotes.options.nakshatra.shatabhisha: शततारका, the Marathi usage for Shatabhisha.
reviewNotes.relations.brotherInLaw: मेहुणे; भाऊजी / दाजी (sister's husband) and दीर are other brothers-in-law.
reviewNotes.relations.sisterInLaw: वहिनी is the brother's wife; नणंद / मेहुणी are other sisters-in-law.
reviewNotes.relations.paternalUncle: काका is the father's brother; Marathi uses काका for uncles in general too.
reviewNotes.relations.uncle: काका, the general Marathi word for an uncle (same as paternal uncle).
reviewNotes.relations.aunt: काकू, the general Marathi word for an aunt.
reviewNotes.relations.cousin: चुलत भाऊ / बहीण is the paternal cousin; मावस / आते / मामे भाऊ are others.
reviewNotes.titles.marriageBiodata: विवाह बायोडाटा; लग्नाचा बायोडाटा or वधू-वर परिचय are alternatives.
reviewNotes.words.am: Kept as AM/PM; Marathi biodatas also write सकाळी / संध्याकाळी before the time.
reviewNotes.fields.intiPeru: Step 2.0 (Telugu chip): the family name a Telugu biodata prints before the given name (ఇంటి పేరు); drafted as the usual word for 'surname'.
reviewNotes.fields.devak: Step 2.0 (Marathi chip): the family's devak (clan totem); transliterated.
reviewNotes.fields.gan: Step 2.0: gana used in guna matching (Deva / Manushya / Rakshasa).
reviewNotes.fields.maslak: Step 2.0 (Muslim chip): school or jamaat (Hanafi, Deobandi, Barelvi…); transliterated.
reviewNotes.titles.bioData: Step 2.0: the hyphenated 'Bio-Data' spelling many printed biodatas use.
